briefing.headline: Soft landing intact as growth holds steady and inflation creeps closer to target.

quotable_numbers.sentence: Core CPI at 2.6 percent for Sep 2026 sits just above the Fed's target, allowing rates to ease.
Real GDP grew 2.3 percent in Q3 2026, steady enough to keep unemployment at 4.1 percent.

briefing.whats_new: Today: 10-Year Treasury lower, from 4.91 percent to 4.85 percent.
